## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A twelve-fascicle late-Míng / early-Qīng commentary on the *Sìfēn prātimokṣa* by **Hóngzàn** 弘贊 ([弘贊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E8%B4%8A), 1611–1685). 繹 *yì* "drawn out / unraveled" indicates the methodical-elucidatory commentary genre.

**Abstract**

Hóngzàn's *Rúshì* is one of the most extensive late-Míng / early-Qīng commentaries on the *Sìfēn prātimokṣa*, providing systematic rule-by-rule exposition for monastic instruction. As a Vinaya specialist, Hóngzàn approached the *prātimokṣa* with particular attention to procedural-practical detail. Together with his *Fànwǎngjīng púsàjiè lüèshū* ([KR6k0098](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0098)), this work represents Hóngzàn's complete dual-Vinaya commentary apparatus (Sìfēn + Fànwǎng).
